g.text: Expected hits: 54.25 with all descriptors; 48.20 without component; 56.71 without property category.

g.text: Lines show paired 95% operator-bootstrap intervals. The full model uses component, material, property category and class location.

g.text: Differences assess incremental information at a fixed review budget; both intervals include positive and negative changes.
